project: Weave Self-Iteration Time Travel Contract Tightening
description: Small Ralph self-iteration for branch ralph/self-iteration-20260519-160430. The previous active PRD belonged to ralph/self-iteration-20260519-143531 and all stories were passing, so it was archived under scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260519-160821/. No PR CI auto-fix context was present in progress.txt. Kickoff health: latest GitHub main CI run 26084194923 completed green on commit 1db8055 while Codespaces prebuild 26084194762 was still in progress; local sampled checks for known fresh-CI risks passed via `go test ./cmd/server -run 'TestBuildEmbeddingProvider|TestEmbeddedWebDist|TestSPA|TestCI'` and `npm --prefix web test -- --run src/components/admin/__tests__/ComplianceReportsPage.test.tsx`. The earlier dogfood findings for Northwind seeding and Dashboard object type totals already have current regression coverage, so this PRD focuses on current OSv2 Time Travel and admin download contract gaps found during inspection.

userStories.name: Signal truncated Time Travel history
userStories.description: Make the dataset history API and Time Travel toolbar explicitly signal when the transaction chain is capped, so operators do not mistake the newest 1000 rows for the complete audit timeline.
bdd_acceptance: Given a dataset has more than 1000 transactions, When the operator or SDK requests `/api/v2/datasets/{rid}/history`, Then the response contains the newest 1000 rows and `truncated: true`.
Given a dataset has 1000 or fewer transactions, When history is requested, Then the response contains all available rows and `truncated: false`.
Given the Browser Time Travel toolbar receives a truncated history response, When it renders the picker, Then it shows a concise hint that only the latest 1000 transactions are available.

userStories.name: Show rollback status in Time Travel picker
userStories.description: Use the existing rollback audit fields on dataset transactions to label rolled-back checkpoints in the Browser Time Travel picker and active historical badge.
bdd_acceptance: Given a history row includes `rolledBackAt`, When the Time Travel picker renders, Then the option is labeled as rolled back without hiding the transaction.
Given a rolled-back transaction points to `rolledBackToTxId`, When the option renders, Then the label includes the rollback target short id.
Given a rolled-back transaction is currently active, When the toolbar renders, Then the active badge warns that the selected checkpoint was rolled back.

userStories.name: Decode standards-compliant admin download filenames
userStories.description: Parse RFC 5987 `Content-Disposition` filenames for compliance and GDPR downloads so operator-supplied report names survive standards-compliant server headers.
bdd_acceptance: Given the compliance report response includes `filename*=UTF-8''control%20evidence.pdf`, When the browser downloads the report, Then the saved filename is `control evidence.pdf`.
Given the GDPR export response includes a quoted fallback filename, When the browser downloads the ZIP, Then the existing quoted filename behavior still works.
Given the attachment filename header is malformed, When the report downloads, Then the UI falls back to the deterministic default filename.
